name: Slim Fit Jeans
suggestions: Add a model-height / inseam guide - half of the (few) fit complaints reference leg length rather than size.
Keep the size chart as-is: 82% true-to-size with complete measurements is the store benchmark.
Add fabric stretch info to the listing - rigid denim surprises buyers who are used to stretch fits.

Waist is true to size, exactly what the chart said
